build_masked_tensor_contiguous: build a MaskedTensor and ensure its data and mask are contiguous in memory
create_masked_tensor_to_dense: create a MaskedTensor and convert it from sparse layout to dense strided layout
create_masked_tensor_to_sparse: create a MaskedTensor and convert it to sparse COO layout with coalesced mask
test_masked_tensor_where: test the masked tensor where operation that selects elements from two masked tensors based on a condition
run_masked_tensor_softmax: run masked tensor softmax with masked values excluded from the normalization computation
